title: Spending on interest on the federal debt rose 52% in two years
summary: Department of Finance Canada spent $48.1 billion on interest on the federal debt in 2024-25, up from $31.7 billion in 2022-23. Official program name: Market Debt and Foreign Reserves Management.

title: Spending on benefits paid out through the CRA more than doubled in two years
summary: Canada Revenue Agency spent $16.2 billion on benefits paid out through the CRA in 2024-25, up from $7.7 billion in 2022-23. Official program name: Benefits.

title: Spending on employer payments for public servants more than doubled in two years
summary: Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat spent $10.7 billion on employer payments for public servants in 2024-25, up from $3.8 billion in 2022-23. Official program name: Public Service Employer Payments.

title: Spending on settling Indigenous land claims more than doubled in two years
summary: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada spent $8.4 billion on settling Indigenous land claims in 2024-25, up from $3.6 billion in 2022-23. Official program name: Specific Claims.
department: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada

title: Spending on military aircraft more than tripled in two years
summary: National Defence spent $3.3 billion on military aircraft in 2024-25, up from $945 million in 2022-23. Official program name: Aerospace Equipment Acquisition.

title: Spending on vaccination programs fell 87% in two years
summary: Public Health Agency of Canada spent $318 million on vaccination programs in 2024-25, down from $2.5 billion in 2022-23. Official program name: Vaccination.

title: Spending on emergency response and disaster recovery fell 83% in two years
summary: Public Safety Canada spent $426 million on emergency response and disaster recovery in 2024-25, down from $2.5 billion in 2022-23. Official program name: Emergency Response/Recovery.

title: Spending on infectious disease control fell 92% in two years
summary: Public Health Agency of Canada spent $129 million on infectious disease control in 2024-25, down from $1.6 billion in 2022-23. Official program name: Communicable Disease and Infection Control.

title: Spending on veterans' disability benefits rose 53% in two years
summary: Veterans Affairs Canada spent $4.2 billion on veterans' disability benefits in 2024-25, up from $2.7 billion in 2022-23. Official program name: Disability Benefits.

title: Spending on asylum claims more than doubled in two years
summary: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada spent $2.3 billion on asylum claims in 2024-25, up from $904 million in 2022-23. Official program name: Asylum.

title: Spending on housing capacity funding grew more than 7-fold in two years
summary: Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation spent $1.3 billion on housing capacity funding in 2024-25, up from $169 million in 2022-23. Official program name: Housing expertise and capacity development.

title: Spending on clean transportation programs grew more than 4-fold in two years
summary: Transport Canada spent $1.2 billion on clean transportation programs in 2024-25, up from $294 million in 2022-23. Official program name: Climate Change and Clean Air.

title: Spending on energy efficiency programs more than tripled in two years
summary: Natural Resources Canada spent $1.2 billion on energy efficiency programs in 2024-25, up from $357 million in 2022-23. Official program name: Energy Efficiency.

title: Spending on new Coast Guard ships more than tripled in two years
summary: Fisheries and Oceans Canada spent $1.2 billion on new Coast Guard ships in 2024-25, up from $388 million in 2022-23. Official program name: Fleet Procurement.

title: Spending on military operations abroad more than doubled in two years
summary: National Defence spent $983 million on military operations abroad in 2024-25, up from $351 million in 2022-23. Official program name: International Operations.

title: Spending on climate adaptation grew more than 27-fold in two years
summary: Environment and Climate Change Canada spent $570 million on climate adaptation in 2024-25, up from $21 million in 2022-23. Official program name: Climate Change Adaptation.

title: Spending on refugee resettlement fell 40% in two years
summary: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada spent $640 million on refugee resettlement in 2024-25, down from $1.1 billion in 2022-23. Official program name: Refugee Resettlement.

title: Spending on homelessness funding rose 54% in two years
summary: Office of Infrastructure of Canada spent $752 million on homelessness funding in 2024-25, up from $489 million in 2022-23. Official program name: Homelessness Funding Oversight.

title: Spending on federal payroll rose 51% in two years
summary: Public Services and Procurement Canada spent $683 million on federal payroll in 2024-25, up from $453 million in 2022-23. Official program name: Federal Pay Administration.

title: Spending on passport services was cut by more than half in two years
summary: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada spent $121 million on passport services in 2024-25, down from $318 million in 2022-23. Official program name: Passport.
